name: EchoNet-Dynamic: Cardiac Ultrasound Video Dataset for Ejection Fraction Assessment
description: EchoNet-Dynamic is a large-scale multimodal cardiac ultrasound video benchmark developed by Stanford University School of Medicine and published in Nature. The dataset comprises 10,030 apical-4-chamber echocardiogram videos (DICOM/AVI format, 112x112 resolution, standardizing at 50 frames per video) from patients who underwent routine diagnostic echocardiography at Stanford Health Care between 2016 and 2018. Each video is paired with expert frame-by-frame left ventricular endocardial border tracings at end-systole and end-diastole, along with clinical tabular measurements of left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF), end-systolic volume (ESV), and end-diastolic volume (EDV) for beat-to-beat cardiac functional modeling.
